verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a built-in Graph that is a 'live, visual map of every Object in your Channel and how they connect' (docs-9), and its linking docs support tracing how ideas relate (docs-28, docs-40), so the core graph view is the product's own capability. Nothing in the evidence shows the graph can be filtered (by type, tag, depth or similar), which is an explicit part of the story, and how interactive the graph is goes beyond 'live' without detail. missing for 10: documented graph filtering controls, detail on interactive exploration (navigation, local or depth views), independent or hands-on corroboration of the graph.
